findings.title: Fallback locales are not loaded outside of web requests (e.g. background jobs, mailers, rake tasks, or I18n.with_locale)
findings.body: `FallbackLocaleList#ensure_loaded!` is only called from `ApplicationController#set_locale`. Because `lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb` lazily loads locale YAML files on demand and `I18n.translate` (line 68) only loads `config.locale` and not its fallbacks, any translation performed outside a controller request (Sidekiq jobs, mailers, scheduled tasks, console, specs) or inside an `I18n.with_locale(...)` block will not have the fallback locales (`SiteSetting.default_locale` and `:en`) loaded into `I18n.backend`. When a key is missing in the active locale, `I18n::Backend::Fallbacks` will query the backend for the fallback locales without triggering `load_locale`, finding no translations loaded for them and returning a missing-translation result instead of falling back.

findings.title: Translation LRU cache is not invalidated and does not key on SiteSetting.default_locale
findings.body: `I18n.translate` caches parameterless translations under the key `"#{key}#{config.locale}#{config.backend.object_id}"`. With `FallbackLocaleList` now using `SiteSetting.default_locale` as the intermediate fallback before `:en`, changing `SiteSetting.default_locale` at runtime will leave stale fallback results in `@cache` for any user locale that fell back to the previous site default locale, and may also serve lookups from before the new default locale's YAML files were loaded.
